body.name: Connected regular real-model cell
body.construction: Conditional on the source-prime chart hypothesis and successful finite output of \(\mathrm{thm:conditional\mbox{-}geometric\mbox{-}resolution}\), \(\mathcal C_{G,e}\) is a connected cell of a smooth semialgebraic stratification of \(\mathcal M_G\setminus\mathcal E_{G,e}\), refined by the signs used in \(\mathsf{LiftCert}\), on which the number and extendability labels of the simple real roots of \(p_e\) are constant.
